How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

Hi, normally, tracking is emailed as soon as the order ships.

For Heirloom orders, customers choose an estimated delivery date at checkout, and the order is scheduled to ship in time to meet that timeframe. If no delivery date was selected, such as with Shop Pay or PayPal, one is automatically assigned on the order confirmation.

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
you need the package sent to a different address, the best next step is to call our customer care team as soon as possible so they can review the order with you.

Shipping address changes are handled by phone because updating the destination can change taxes based on the new location, and any payment adjustment needs to be processed securely at the same time.

Our team can be reached at (800) 820-0465. We are available Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST.
